ticket.title: Shared target-dir serialises every suite build behind one lock

task.title: Shared target-dir serialises every suite build behind one lock

events.title: Shared target-dir: already decided, not a finding (withdrawn)
events.description:
CORRECTED 2026-11-08: this ticket should not have been filed. The shared target directory at the suite root is an
already-settled arrangement, not a discovery, and it was re-reported here as though it were new after a build lock held
up an install during the GB-339 telemetry work.

What happened, so the record is honest: two `cargo install` runs were started in parallel, the second blocked on the
build directory lock, and I described the serialisation to the user as a suite-level finding. It was not new. The
behaviour is the direct consequence of `target-dir = "target"` in the root `.cargo/config.toml`, which is deliberate
and already understood.

No code change, no investigation, and no ADR is owed. The observation stands - installs serialise, and a heavy
dependency starves other builds - but it is a known property rather than a defect waiting to be triaged.

Retained rather than deleted because the ledger is append-only and a withdrawn ticket is more useful than a silently
absent one.
